key_messages: Scattered showers and isolated storms are forecast across east central Florida today and could aggravate sensitive locations that remain fully saturated and flooded. Lightning, gusty winds, and even small hail will be possible with the strongest storms that develop.
Hazardous beach and boating conditions continue through today, though a slow improvement is anticipated through the remainder of this weekend.
Prolonged river flooding continues along the St. Johns River due to recent heavy rainfall across the basin. Any additional rainfall will lead to additional rises.
afd.hydrology: River flood warnings remain in effect for Cocoa (COCF1), Geneva (GENF1), Astor (ASTF1), Deland (DLAF1) and Sanford (SNFF1) on the St. Johns River. All five river points are either actively in Major Flood Stage or are forecast to reach it in the coming days. Prolonged flooding impacts along the St. Johns are anticipated, and any additional rainfall across the basin may lead to additional rises. River forecasts out five days are issued twice daily by the NWS Southeast River Forecast Center in collaboration with NWS Melbourne and are available at water.noaa.gov/wfo/MLB.
